common_false_positives.why_false: A document that exists on paper but is not communicated, enforced, or embedded in practice does not demonstrate Developing capability. Implementation evidence is required.

common_false_positives.signal: Senior leaders have expressed interest or concern about AI in this area.
common_false_positives.why_false: Interest and concern are not the same as planned action. Developing requires concrete steps: assigned responsibility, documented plans, initiated pilots, or allocated resources.

threshold_evidence.minimum: At least one documented, institutionally sanctioned initiative in ai research with named responsibility and a defined scope.
threshold_evidence.strong: Multiple coordinated initiatives in ai research with institutional backing, documented progress, and a pathway to broader adoption.

key_discriminator: The transition from Developing to Advanced in AI Research is marked by the shift from pilot or project-based AI initiatives to institution-wide embedded practice with continuous improvement.

common_false_positives.signal: AI is used across the institution in ai research but adoption is uncoordinated.
common_false_positives.why_false: Widespread but uncoordinated use without quality assurance, governance integration, or systematic improvement is Developing. Advanced requires embedded, governed, institution-wide practice.

common_false_positives.signal: A comprehensive AI strategy for ai research has been published.
common_false_positives.why_false: Strategy without embedded practice and evidence of continuous improvement is Developing. Advanced requires the strategy to be implemented, measured, and iterated.

common_false_positives.signal: The institution has invested significantly in AI tools for this area.
common_false_positives.why_false: Investment in tools without evidence of systematic adoption, effectiveness measurement, and continuous improvement does not demonstrate Advanced capability. Tools must be embedded in practice.

threshold_evidence.minimum: Evidence that ai research AI practices are institution-wide (not just in pilots), governed, and subject to quality monitoring.
threshold_evidence.strong: Documented evidence of continuous improvement cycles in ai research: measured outcomes, identified improvements, implemented changes, and re-measured results.
